model_params.input: capacity_ah only, standardised with TRAIN batteries' statistics; target standardised likewise and inverted at prediction

split.protocol: LEAVE-ONE-BATTERY-OUT (LOBO): each of B0005, B0006, B0018 is held out in turn and predicted by a model fitted on the other two batteries only; no cycle of the test battery is in training. B0007 is EXCLUDED: it is censored — its capacity never crosses the 1.4 Ah end-of-life threshold (last recorded 1.432 Ah), so it has no observed EOL label.

preprocessing.target: rul_cycles_eol (discharge cycles until capacity first < 1.4 Ah = 70% of the 2 Ah rating)
preprocessing.note: capacity_ah / soh are measured per-cycle health indicators and are inputs (standard for capacity-trajectory RUL); cycle_index counts discharge cycles of that battery only

notes: Real laboratory battery-aging data (NASA Ames PCoE, Saha & Goebel 2007). LOBO over 3 batteries is a small-sample evaluation: per-battery numbers are reported individually, not hidden in the pooled score.

extra.scoring_note: the first 10 discharge cycles of each held-out battery have no full window and are not scored by the sequence model (the RF scores every cycle)
